notable_absence.finding: ADVISE is the first statement in this batch whose Prerequisites section names no fixed capella-role or credential-type privilege at all - it explicitly defers to whatever privileges the *wrapped* query (SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/USING AI) requires ('your client must have necessary privileges for the SQL++ statement for which you want advice'). This is a derived/inherited privilege model, structurally different from every other statement in this batch (ALTER BUCKET/GROUP/SEQUENCE/USER), which each name a fixed, statement-specific gate.

cross_product_finding: Recurrence of the known anomaly (docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json): 'You can use ADVISE with USING AI only in Couchbase Server 8.0 and later.' - a literal server/-style version string cited on a Capella page, despite Capella having no discrete version number.
